history.summary: Freehold D12 2BR (807 sqft) at $1.39M / $1,721 psf, just above the $1,699 median, an 8-min walk to Boon Keng NEL. Well-sized 2BR at a sub-$1.5M quantum hits the deepest buyer band, but the 3.57%/yr URA rate (48 txns, reliable) is modest for an RCR-fringe freehold.
history.rating_rationale: Best liquidity profile in this batch — proper-sized 2BR, $1.39M quantum in the deep band, 48-txn reliable data, MRT-proximate. Offset by only 3.57%/yr appreciation (below RCR norm) and PSF marginally over median, so upside is capped. Net balanced; a steady hold, not a standout.
catalysts: Freehold city-fringe D12 within walk of Boon Keng NEL
